title: Javier Barros Sierra es nombrado rector de la UNAM.
text: Javier Barros Sierra fue un ingeniero, matemático, académico, empresario y funcionario público mexicano, quien fue rector de la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México durante el conflicto estudiantil de 1968 y el primer secretario de Obras Públicas.

title: Se inaugura el Estadio Azteca con el partido entre América de México y Torino de Italia.
text: El Torino Football Club, conocido simplemente como Torino o simplificado el Toro,​ es un club de fútbol italiano, de la ciudad de Turín, capital de la región de Piamonte. El equipo juega en la Serie A, la máxima categoría del fútbol profesional en Italia.

title: Se desborda el Río Pánuco causando graves daños en los estados de Veracruz y Tamaulipas.
text: El río Pánuco es un río mexicano de la vertiente del golfo de México, que nace en la Altiplanicie Mexicana y forma parte del sistema hidrológico conocido como Tula-Moctezuma-Pánuco. Pánuco es el nombre que recibe en su curso bajo, desde Veracruz.

title: May 19–September 19 – Display of prints by Victorian artist Aubrey Beardsley at the Victoria and Albert Museum, London; in July it is threatened with prosecution for obscenity.
text: Aubrey Vincent Beardsley was an English illustrator and author. His black ink drawings were influenced by Japanese woodcuts, and depicted the grotesque, the decadent, and the erotic.

title: The Chicago Surrealist Group is founded by Franklin and Penelope Rosemont with others.
text: Franklin Rosemont was an American poet, artist, historian, street speaker, and co-founder of the Chicago Surrealist Group. Over four decades, Franklin produced a body of work, of declarations, manifestos, poetry, collage, hidden histories, and other interventions.

title: American pop artist Jim Dine is found guilty of exhibiting indecent works at Robert Fraser's gallery in London.
text: Jim Dine is an American visual artist. Dine's work includes painting, drawing, printmaking (in many forms including lithographs, etchings, gravure, intaglio, woodcuts, letterpress, and linocuts), sculpture, and photography.

title: New Whitney Museum of American Art on Madison Avenue in New York City, designed by Marcel Breuer with Hamilton P. Smith, is opened.
text: Madison Avenue is a north–south avenue in the borough of Manhattan in New York City, New York, that carries northbound one-way traffic. It runs from Madison Square to meet the southbound Harlem River Drive at 142nd Street, passing through Midtown, the Upper East Side (including Carnegie Hill), East Harlem, and Harlem.

title: October 13–23 – The second New York City Armory Show 9 Evenings: Theatre and Engineering sponsored by E.A.T. – Experiments in Art and Technology.
text: The 1913 Armory Show, also known as the International Exhibition of Modern Art, was organized by the Association of American Painters and Sculptors. It was the first large exhibition of modern art in America, as well as one of the many exhibitions that have been held in the vast spaces of U.S. National Guard armories.
